newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SEBI suspends three brokers.
newsitem.headline: India's SEBI suspends three brokers.

text.p: Market regulator the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) said on Friday it suspended three brokers with effect from May 1.

SEBI said the suspended brokers were Mohini Agarwal of Mohini & Co and Sunil Kumar Agarwal of Laxmi and Sons -- both from the Uttar Pradesh stock exchange -- and Pradip R. Javeri of S.D. Javeri from the Bombay Stock Exchange.

The regulator said the brokers will "not be entitled to carry on the business as a stock broker with effect from 1st May to 31st July and they will not be allowed to operate in their individual or corporate membership in any exchange during the period of suspension."
SEBI said they had been suspended for violating rules and regulations of the SEBI Act. It did not give additional details.
